fields.description: Cedarwood Estates South is Wasl’s additional 74-villa release within Jumeirah Golf Estates: The Next Chapter. Four-, five- and six-bedroom homes combine private pools and courtyards with ground, first and roof levels. This collection is separate from the original 121-villa Cedarwood Estates phase.
